summary: Official Sierra Leone land-administration custodians and services were found, but no public anonymous Kenema parcel viewer, vector API, safe native parcel identity, or full parcel polygon was qualified. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Krio discovery queries, exact text and actual result URLs are recorded in city-1142-kenema.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET https://app.molhcp.gov.sl/ returned HTTP 200. The current MLHCP HTML exposed public service pages (services.aspx, login.aspx, register.aspx) and describes land registration and cadastral survey requests, but no map JavaScript, public map configuration, or anonymous parcel API. TLS-verified GET https://www.nlc.gov.sl/digital-portal returned HTTP 200; its rendered page explicitly labels the Digital Land Portal Coming Soon and the LMIS Under Development, with interactive cadastral maps listed as a planned feature. TLS-verified GET https://sllap.molhcp.gov.sl/ returned HTTP 200; the project site describes land-information-system development and registration work, but exposed no public parcel service. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception was used.
